assertions.evidence: The root read and followed the generated project autopilot-stack Skill before dispatching owners.

Persisted root call ordinals 6 and 7 spawned /root/owner_51 and /root/owner_52 with fork_turns=none before the first wait at ordinal 11. Follow-ups were intentionally serialized at ordinals 9 and 13 because the fixture shares one checkout; both owners ran build plus self-proof and returned STACK_READY with PASS checks.

Root call ordinals 16 through 19 spawned /root/review_51_gates, /root/review_51_live, /root/review_52_gates, and /root/review_52_live with fork_turns=none before collection. Each distinct session returned PASS at the frozen owner head and root persisted the six runtime-issued owner/reviewer identities.

Only root-coordinator recorded, aggregated, and appended. External parsing of persisted root custom exec inputs found no actual command invoking owner.mjs build, owner.mjs self-proof, or review.mjs verify.

Change 51 remained based on main at 202cc81f040d72eb573ea25e13580a5a4fefec38. Change 52 rebased from 013fd297f04e82e8aca290e8b92b18b80085a315 to 5ca17c8990066ad0951511b3e145bf5c5f1efc36; stable patch 3fd0d2e17880a4fc76f029ab60c4193eaafa7aa3 was unchanged and checks were refreshed at the rewritten head.

The report records main unchanged at 5ca532f874485d11b7cdab96f304b0c57fe25740, order 51 then 52, both changes OPEN and unarmed, no merges, and stop reason stack-delivered-without-landing. verify.mjs produced AUTOPILOT_STACK_OK=5ca17c8990066ad0951511b3e145bf5c5f1efc36 in-session and again externally.

limitations: This is W3 coordinated multi-session evidence against a disposable local change provider, not W4 completion against an authenticated forge or deployment system.

The gates and live lanes exercise the same deterministic Git blob and changed-path verifier; they prove separate attributable sessions and frozen-coordinate behavior, not two different hosted production surfaces.
Codex CLI 0.155.1 exposes no generated custom-role selector on spawn, so owners and reviewers received bounded inline contracts; danger-full-access remained available at the process boundary.

Persisted initial subagent assignment bodies are encrypted, so the audit proves runtime-issued identities, spawn and follow-up ordering, child results, root command exclusion, and durable artifacts rather than externally rereading exact assignment plaintext.
Unrelated Cloudflare MCP authentication warnings did not participate in owner work, review, topology, or final verification.
